note: Appendix feature sweep over the synthetic sweep credentials generated by host/examples/paper_sweep.rs. Cases of class probe exercise features the guest is expected to reject or that have no effect on a credential dataset; probe-query-blank-node is an ordinary basic graph pattern (a query blank node is an existential variable).
